relevance_note: Case report of one girl with compound heterozygous LPIN2 variants ("Whole-exome sequencing revealed a novel compound heterozygous mutation in LPIN2"), her carrier parents, and a literature table (Table 1) of 35 previously published patients with individual-level data.
method_note: Proband labelled 'patient' (single unnamed case; 'the proband' is a role word); parents labelled 'mother of patient' and 'father of patient' (tested carriers, no phenotype stated; 'no family history of similar symptoms' was not used to exclude anything). Table 1 (35 literature patients, labels A1-P2 from the 'Case' column, which uses label-like values) was transcribed by a Python script in the scratch directory; its output was checked against the table (every span asserted verbatim, cell counts checked). The 'Author (Year)' cell is copied to source_reference_in_review. The Table 1 legend defines '+, present; –, absent; NR, not reported'; '–' cells are recorded as excluded with the legend quoted as a second span. Composite checklist items ('joint or limb swelling', 'neutrophilic dermatosis (Sweet syndrome)') are not excluded by a '–' in the narrower 'Joint swelling' / 'Sweet syndrome' columns (feature rows only). CDA (column and proband text) is recorded as a phenotypic feature only; the checklist item 'dyserythropoiesis on bone marrow' is left not reported because no marrow dyserythropoiesis is described per person (proband marrow: 21% erythroid precursors, mild anisocytosis). Hb, MCV, ESR and CRP numeric columns of Table 1 were not converted to features or checklist statuses (no per-patient reference ranges or abnormal labels); ranges such as '52–79' are not stacked cells. Table 2 counts (e.g. 'Heterozygous mutation 5/35', 'Elevated inflammatory markers 23/26') name no one and were not used. Zygosity, variant type and pathogenicity for Table 1 patients are not reported per patient. K1 lists two variants ('c.2327+1G>C; c.1691_1694delGAGA'), recorded as two rows. Proband: 'occasional redness' during episodes vs 'without erythema' at admission examination; both feature rows emitted and checklist 'warmth or redness over bone or joint' left not reported. 'no history of rash' not used to exclude neutrophilic dermatosis. Normal leukocyte count was not used to exclude neutropenia. Height/weight given without percentiles: growth items not reported. Negative infectious workup not recorded as a feature. qRT-PCR: half-normal LPIN2 transcript in proband and mother is not attributed by the paper to a specific variant, so it is recorded only on the mother's c.2349del row (sentence names her), not on the proband's c.2349del row. Possible errors/inconsistencies in the paper, recorded as printed: A3 and A4 protein 'p.Ser735Leu'/'p.Ser736Leu' with the same c.2201C>T as A1/A2 'p.Ser734Leu'; A1/A2 year printed '(1,989)' and A1 cDNA 'c.2,201C>T'; J1-J3 'c.2208G>A (p.R736H)' vs N1 'c.2207G>A (p.Arg736His)'; Herlin et al. (2012) in Table 1 vs 2013 in the reference list; Liu et al. (2020) vs 2019 in ref 9; P2 has CRMO '–' and CDA '–' yet is listed among Majeed patients; Table 2 says CRMO 33/35 and CDA 29/34. Abstract says the RNA analysis established pathogenicity of the splice variant, while the Discussion says exon 17 skipping did not affect mRNA level (recorded as functional evidence). Figure 4 legend says 'the father and the patient have abnormal cutting bands'. n_patients_reported left null: the paper states 35 literature patients plus one new case but never states a combined number; cites_prior_report_of_same_patients left null (the new case is first-hand; the 35 are a literature review captured per person via source_reference_in_review).
